title: Vagal Auricular Stimulation for Motion Sickness
official: Central Mechanisms of Nausea and Their Modulation Via Non-invasive Neurostimulation
summary: This study aims to understand the mechanisms underlying nausea response in the brain stem, and the effect of vagal nerve stimulation on nausea.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18-65 years old (inclusive)
* Ability to give written consent and participate in behavioral intervention in English
* Avoidance of alcohol, nicotine, and caffeine for 24 hours prior to study session
* Motion Sickness Susceptibility Questionnaire (MSSQ) percentile score \> 60.
* Adequate visual, hearing, cognitive, and physical ability

Exclusion Criteria:

* Chronic nausea due to medications or gastrointestinal conditions
* Prior or current history of seizures
* Severe autonomic dysfunction
* No active clinical acupuncture therapy
* History of arrhythmias
* Endorses any contraindications to MRI
* Body weight of 450 lbs or greater or BMI of 32 kg/m2 or greater (limit of MRI table)
* History any serious medical condition (e.g., cancer)
* Pregnancy/breastfeeding within the last 8 weeks
* Uncontrolled diabetes (indicated by HbA1c ³ 7%) by chart
* Narcotic analgesics greater than three days per week
* Illicit drugs or opioid usage
* Cannabinoid use greater than three days per week
* Intellectual disability by history
* Illiteracy
* Inability to provide informed consent
* Any other condition interfering with study requirements, according to the investigator
